sector-7-slums.title: Sector 7 Slums
sector-7-slums.content: A dense sprawl of neon-lit alleys and vertical housing. Home to hackers, hustlers, and those the corporations forgot.
sector-7-slums.lore: A dense sprawl of neon-lit alleys and vertical housing. Home to hackers, hustlers, and those the corporations forgot.

glitch.title: Glitch
glitch.content:
A legendary netrunner with a cybernetic eye and a vendetta against Arasaka. They can bypass almost any ICE.

Currently planning [[The Arasaka Data Heist]].
glitch.lore:
A legendary netrunner with a cybernetic eye and a vendetta against Arasaka. They can bypass almost any ICE.

Currently planning [[The Arasaka Data Heist]].

chrome-eyes.title: Chrome-Eyes
chrome-eyes.content: A back-alley street doc who specializes in high-end cybernetics. He knows the medical history of every runner in the slums.
chrome-eyes.lore: A back-alley street doc who specializes in high-end cybernetics. He knows the medical history of every runner in the slums.

net-ghosts.title: The Net-Ghosts
net-ghosts.content: A global collective of netrunners fighting for data sovereignty and corporate transparency.
net-ghosts.lore: A global collective of netrunners fighting for data sovereignty and corporate transparency.

cyber-hound.title: K9-Cyber Hound
cyber-hound.content: A high-speed mechanical predator equipped with scent-tracking sensors and shock-jaws.
cyber-hound.lore: A high-speed mechanical predator equipped with scent-tracking sensors and shock-jaws.

cyberdeck-blueprint.title: Blueprint: Mark IV Cyberdeck
cyberdeck-blueprint.content: Detailed schematics for a custom netrunning rig featuring multi-core processing and specialized ICE-breakers.
cyberdeck-blueprint.lore: Detailed schematics for a custom netrunning rig featuring multi-core processing and specialized ICE-breakers.

the-arasaka-data-heist.title: The Arasaka Data Heist
the-arasaka-data-heist.content: A high-risk operation to infiltrate the Arasaka mainframe and steal classified neural mapping data.
the-arasaka-data-heist.lore: A high-risk operation to infiltrate the Arasaka mainframe and steal classified neural mapping data.

neon-strip.title: The Neon Strip
neon-strip.content: Six blocks of vendors, noodle carts and unlicensed clinics under a canopy of advertising. Everything is for sale and nothing has a receipt.
neon-strip.lore: Six blocks of vendors, noodle carts and unlicensed clinics under a canopy of advertising. Everything is for sale and nothing has a receipt.

vertical-stacks.title: The Vertical Stacks
vertical-stacks.content: Forty floors of converted cargo housing. The lifts fail weekly, so the upper stacks have their own economy and their own rules.
vertical-stacks.lore: Forty floors of converted cargo housing. The lifts fail weekly, so the upper stacks have their own economy and their own rules.

static-bar.title: Static Bar
static-bar.content: A basement bar where the music is loud enough to defeat directional microphones. Deals happen at the back booths; nobody looks.
static-bar.lore: A basement bar where the music is loud enough to defeat directional microphones. Deals happen at the back booths; nobody looks.

helix-tower.title: Helix Tower
helix-tower.content: Ninety floors of mirrored glass with its own weather. Visible from every alley in Sector 7, which is the point.
helix-tower.lore: Ninety floors of mirrored glass with its own weather. Visible from every alley in Sector 7, which is the point.

drowned-district.title: The Drowned District
drowned-district.content: Twelve blocks that went under when the seawall failed and were never reclaimed. The grid still runs down there, which is why people go.
drowned-district.lore: Twelve blocks that went under when the seawall failed and were never reclaimed. The grid still runs down there, which is why people go.

cathedral-node.title: Cathedral Node
cathedral-node.content: A decommissioned church whose nave now holds server racks. The Net-Ghosts route their heaviest traffic through its cold, quiet dark.
cathedral-node.lore: A decommissioned church whose nave now holds server racks. The Net-Ghosts route their heaviest traffic through its cold, quiet dark.

transit-spine.title: The Transit Spine
transit-spine.content: The maglev line that stitches the sectors together. Corporate cars run the upper rail; everyone else rides below it.
transit-spine.lore: The maglev line that stitches the sectors together. Corporate cars run the upper rail; everyone else rides below it.

vesper-kade.title: Vesper Kade
vesper-kade.content: The fixer who decides which jobs reach which crews. Keeps no files, forgets nothing, and has never once been arrested.
vesper-kade.lore: The fixer who decides which jobs reach which crews. Keeps no files, forgets nothing, and has never once been arrested.

kestrel-9.title: Kestrel-9
kestrel-9.content: Helix Dynamics' field asset for problems that cannot go through legal. Eight confirmed augmentations, none of them cosmetic.
kestrel-9.lore: Helix Dynamics' field asset for problems that cannot go through legal. Eight confirmed augmentations, none of them cosmetic.

mila-ferran.title: Mila Ferran

connections.label: Believes it proves the recall was deliberate

mila-ferran.content: Independent reporter who has been building a case against Helix for three years. Publishes from a different address every week.
mila-ferran.lore: Independent reporter who has been building a case against Helix for three years. Publishes from a different address every week.

rook.title: Rook
rook.content: Runs cargo through the drowned district in a boat that should not float. Charges by risk, not by weight.
rook.lore: Runs cargo through the drowned district in a boat that should not float. Charges by risk, not by weight.

saint-decibel.title: Saint Decibel
saint-decibel.content: Spins at the Static Bar four nights a week and sells what the crowd says on the other three. Information priced by how badly you want it.
saint-decibel.lore: Spins at the Static Bar four nights a week and sells what the crowd says on the other three. Information priced by how badly you want it.

auditor-grey.title: Auditor Grey
auditor-grey.content: Helix's internal auditor, sent down from the tower to find out who has been moving numbers. Does not carry a weapon and does not need to.
auditor-grey.lore: Helix's internal auditor, sent down from the tower to find out who has been moving numbers. Does not carry a weapon and does not need to.

tam-oyelaran.title: Tam Oyelaran
tam-oyelaran.content: Built ICE for Helix for eleven years, then walked out. Now maintains the Cathedral Node for people who cannot pay.
tam-oyelaran.lore: Built ICE for Helix for eleven years, then walked out. Now maintains the Cathedral Node for people who cannot pay.

dr-solene-marrow.title: Dr. Solene Marrow

connections.label: Two ends of the same trade

dr-solene-marrow.content: The legitimate surgeon Helix employees are sent to. Better equipment than Chrome-Eyes, and a waiting list you cannot join.
dr-solene-marrow.lore: The legitimate surgeon Helix employees are sent to. Better equipment than Chrome-Eyes, and a waiting list you cannot join.

helix-dynamics.title: Helix Dynamics
helix-dynamics.content: Biotech megacorp holding the augmentation patents most of the sector depends on. Owns the tower, the upper rail, and a great deal of the council.
helix-dynamics.lore: Biotech megacorp holding the augmentation patents most of the sector depends on. Owns the tower, the upper rail, and a great deal of the council.

red-vector.title: Red Vector
red-vector.content: Street crew running the Vertical Stacks. Sells protection to the same people it threatens, and calls the arrangement stability.
red-vector.lore: Street crew running the Vertical Stacks. Sells protection to the same people it threatens, and calls the arrangement stability.

the-quiet-hand.title: The Quiet Hand
the-quiet-hand.content: A smuggling network older than the seawall. Moves cargo, people and data, and never asks which it is carrying.
the-quiet-hand.lore: A smuggling network older than the seawall. Moves cargo, people and data, and never asks which it is carrying.

sector-council.title: The Sector Council
sector-council.content: Nine elected seats meant to govern Sector 7. Meets publicly, decides privately, and has not refused Helix anything in six years.
sector-council.lore: Nine elected seats meant to govern Sector 7. Meets publicly, decides privately, and has not refused Helix anything in six years.

black-ledger.title: The Black Ledger
black-ledger.content: An encrypted chip carrying Helix's real recall figures. Three parties want it and none of them can decrypt it alone.
black-ledger.lore: An encrypted chip carrying Helix's real recall figures. Three parties want it and none of them can decrypt it alone.

ghostwire-suite.title: Ghostwire ICE-Breaker
ghostwire-suite.content: A hand-built intrusion suite that adapts to ICE rather than brute-forcing it. Three known copies; two are Helix's.
ghostwire-suite.lore: A hand-built intrusion suite that adapts to ICE rather than brute-forcing it. Three known copies; two are Helix's.

neural-shunt.title: Marrow-Grade Neural Shunt

connections.label: Her design, her name on it

neural-shunt.content: A surgical shunt that lets a runner hold a connection far past safe limits. It works. It also shortens the list of things you remember.
neural-shunt.lore: A surgical shunt that lets a runner hold a connection far past safe limits. It works. It also shortens the list of things you remember.

blackout-of-49.title: The Blackout of '49

connections.label: Ran the grid contract that year

blackout-of-49.content: Eleven hours with no grid, no lifts and no lights. Officially a cascade fault. Nobody in the slums believes that.
blackout-of-49.lore: Eleven hours with no grid, no lifts and no lights. Officially a cascade fault. Nobody in the slums believes that.

the-helix-recall.title: The Helix Recall
the-helix-recall.content: Helix quietly recalled a run of neural implants and offered replacements to anyone who signed. Most signed.
the-helix-recall.lore: Helix quietly recalled a run of neural implants and offered replacements to anyone who signed. Most signed.

strip-riots.title: The Strip Riots
strip-riots.content: Four nights of fires along the Neon Strip after a Red Vector shakedown killed a vendor. The council promised an inquiry.
strip-riots.lore: Four nights of fires along the Neon Strip after a Red Vector shakedown killed a vendor. The council promised an inquiry.

sable-drone-swarm.title: Sable Drone Swarm
sable-drone-swarm.content: A maintenance swarm that outlived its contract and kept patrolling. It still repairs things. It still removes what it reads as damage.
sable-drone-swarm.lore: A maintenance swarm that outlived its contract and kept patrolling. It still repairs things. It still removes what it reads as damage.

runners-code.title: The Runner's Code
runners-code.content: Not written anywhere, and everyone can recite it. Do not burn a fixer. Do not touch a clinic. Do not take corporate money to hunt your own.
runners-code.lore: Not written anywhere, and everyone can recite it. Do not burn a fixer. Do not touch a clinic. Do not take corporate money to hunt your own.

ice-protocols.title: ICE Protocols
ice-protocols.content: Working notes on Helix's intrusion countermeasures: what each layer watches for, and how long you have once it notices you.
ice-protocols.lore: Working notes on Helix's intrusion countermeasures: what each layer watches for, and how long you have once it notices you.
